# Greenstein & McDonald

> San Francisco tenant rights law firm specializing in eviction defense, rent control, wrongful eviction, and landlord harassment cases throughout the Bay Area.

Greenstein & McDonald P.C. represents tenants in San Francisco, Oakland, Berkeley, and throughout California in disputes involving just cause evictions, Ellis Act relocations, owner move-in evictions, security deposits, and landlord-tenant conflicts. The firm has secured record verdicts including a $3.5M jury award against landlord Anne Kihagi.

## Key Topics

- Tenant Rights
- Eviction Defense
- Rent Control
- Just Cause Eviction
- Ellis Act
- Wrongful Eviction
- Landlord Harassment
- Owner Move-In Eviction
- Security Deposits
- San Francisco Housing Law
- Oakland Rent Ordinance
- Berkeley Tenant Protections
- California Civil Code 1950.5
- Bay Area Housing Rights
